title: Rep script wording and timing rules
context: D-reps-005 sets the order and bounds; this records the concrete rules the generator and its tests follow.
decision: Script text is the person's words inside fixed templates: step lead by modality and direction (See/Picture/Hear/Say to yourself/Feel/Smell/Taste + content), drivers of the step's modality spoken via a per-attribute template table with fallback 'Make it {peak}.', one core submodality when a step has no driver, auditory-internal steps add a 2 s repeat silence. Speech time is estimated at 2.2 words per second plus a 1.5 s pause per step. Timed steps fill a 32 s target (configurable within 20 to 40 s): spare time is shared in proportion to each step's floor; if floors exceed the target the script runs at the floor; with five or more steps, or if floors exceed 40 s, only the top driver per step is spoken; above 40 s steps are scaled down to 40 s and the runner cuts speech (M2). The anchor-only test is the anchor step's text plus its submodalities and 10 s of silence. scriptHash is FNV-1a over the step kinds and texts. Draft profiles (confirmedAt null) are refused.
author: claude
